power.method: Rechargeable 5000mAh battery (up to 120 days); optional solar panel

release_notes: Distinct SKU from the base Cell Go (IPC-B32): the Full Color (IPC-TB3F-3T0WE) adds spotlight full-color night vision and active deterrence versus the base model's IR night vision. Corrected 2026-10-30 against the official Imou spec sheet: night_vision range_m 7 (base Cell Go value) -> 15, field_of_view_deg 98 H -> 98 H / 54 V / 121 D, added sensor 1/2.8" and H.264, added model codes IPC-TB3F-3T0WE(/FSP12-TYPEC); the spec page gives 168.1 x 72.2 x 60.6 mm / 270 g but the product datasheet gives 88 x 63 x 41 mm / 180 g, so dimensions and weight are left unchanged pending a check.

frigate.notes: 100% wire-free battery camera — it sleeps between events and does not expose a continuous local RTSP stream, so Frigate/local-NVR use is not supported. Recording is via the Imou Life app + cloud and on-device microSD.
